admission.contract: A TLS client `ServerKeyExchange` message is dispatched into the DHE parser and converted into a non-null `DH` candidate plus `EVP_PKEY` holder.
admission.predicate: dispatch.hit && dispatch.is_dhe != 0 && parsed.hit && parsed.time >= dispatch.time && parsed.dh != NULL && parsed.peer_tmp != NULL && parsed.prime_len > 0 && parsed.generator_len > 0 && parsed.pub_key_len > 0
limitations: The source shows the internal DHE handshake parser, but not the exact external byte sequence accepted from the fuzz testcase.
This binds admission at the TLS ServerKeyExchange processing layer rather than a higher-level socket API.

root.contract: After the parsed DHE key is assigned into `peer_tmp`, the security-failure branch still holds the same `DH *` both in local `dh` and inside `peer_tmp`.
root.predicate: fail_after_assign.hit && fail_after_assign.local_dh != NULL && fail_after_assign.peer_tmp != NULL && fail_after_assign.local_dh == fail_after_assign.peer_tmp_dh
limitations: The public issue does not state which condition triggered the security rejection; the aliasing state is inferred from source.
This root is specific to the post-assignment error branch in `tls_process_ske_dhe`.

target.contract: On that error path, cleanup frees `dh` directly and then frees `peer_tmp`, whose legacy destructor consumes the same `DH *` again.
target.predicate: free_local_dh.hit && free_legacy_pkey.hit && free_local_dh.time < free_legacy_pkey.time && free_local_dh.local_dh == root.fail_after_assign.local_dh && free_local_dh.peer_tmp == root.fail_after_assign.peer_tmp && free_legacy_pkey.pkey == root.fail_after_assign.peer_tmp && free_legacy_pkey.legacy_key == root.fail_after_assign.local_dh
limitations: The exact second `DH_free` frame appears through the legacy `EVP_PKEY` destructor path; the source here exposes it as `evp_pkey_free_it`, while the public issue names `evp_pkey_free_legacy`.
The runtime branch into this cleanup still depends on a security-check failure not fully characterized by the public issue text alone.
